LanguageData.MakeHeavyAnimalArmorHuge.label: make heavy animal armor (huge)
LanguageData.MakeHeavyAnimalArmorHuge.description:
Make a set of heavy animal armor out of steel, plasteel and synthread lining.
Fits on animals with a mature body size of 2.4 or greater.

LanguageData.MakeHeavyAnimalArmorLarge.description:
Make a set of heavy animal armor out of steel, plasteel and synthread lining.
Fits on animals with a mature body size of 1.3 or greater, but less than 2.4.
